panels.title: Đường vốn: chiến lược vs mua-và-giữ (run $run_id)

targets.rawSql:
-- Ca hai duong chi DOC tu backtest_equity. Truoc day duong mua-va-giu
-- duoc NOI SUY TUYEN TINH o day (capital -> capital+pnl theo ty le thoi
-- gian): duong thang do co drawdown = 0 nen che mat cu sap that cua
-- benchmark (do that: VCB 2020 sut 39,5%), va la ban thu hai cua cong
-- thuc _buy_and_hold viet bang SQL. Nay run_backtest tinh mot lan, ghi
-- vao cot equity_bh; SQL khong tinh gi nua.
SELECT e.ts AS time, e.equity AS value, 'strategy' AS metric
FROM backtest_equity e
WHERE e.run_id = $run_id
UNION ALL
SELECT e.ts AS time, e.equity_bh AS value, 'buy_and_hold' AS metric
FROM backtest_equity e
WHERE e.run_id = $run_id AND e.equity_bh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS "Thời điểm", side AS "Lệnh", qty AS "KL", price AS "Giá", fee AS "Phí"
FROM backtest_fills WHERE run_id = $run_id ORDER BY ts

SELECT trades AS "Trades",
       win_rate AS "Win rate",
       max_drawdown AS "MaxDD",
       filtered_bars AS "Filtered bars",
       realized_pnl AS "Realized PnL",
       unrealized_pnl AS "Unrealized PnL",
       buy_and_hold_pnl AS "Buy&Hold PnL"
FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id = $run_id

list.name: symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM backtest_runs ORDER BY 1
list.description: Mã chứng khoán có kết quả backtest.

list.name: strategy
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT strategy FROM backtest_runs ORDER BY 1
list.description: Chiến lược đã chạy (chỉ các chiến lược trong STRATEGIES).

list.name: timeframe
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT timeframe FROM backtest_runs ORDER BY 1

list.name: run_id
list.query: SELECT run_id::text, 'run ' || run_id || ' — ' || symbol || ' / ' || strategy || ' / ' || timeframe || ' (' || to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ')' FROM backtest_runs WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND strategy = '$strategy' AND timeframe = '$timeframe' ORDER BY run_id DESC
list.description: Chọn lần chạy cụ thể cho bộ symbol/strategy/timeframe.
